page_title: EIN 1-5 LEV | Eintracht Frankfurt v Bayer Leverkusen 05/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' The corner by Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
90+1' The attendance for today's match is 58000.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' 1 - 5 Goal! Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Kevin Trapp to commit before slotting the penalty into the roof of the net.
89' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
88' The Bayer Leverkusen players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
87' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Bayer Leverkusen! Let's see what he decides.
86' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Bayer Leverkusen for a penalty. Play continues.
85' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner but it's cleared.

85' Nacho (Eintracht Frankfurt) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Eintracht Frankfurt earn a corner.
85' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt).
84' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts. The ball goes out of play. Eintracht Frankfurt are awarded a corner kick.

84' He should have scored! Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. The ball is out of play. Eintracht Frankfurt win a corner kick.
83' Here comes a substitution. Gustavo Puerta (Bayer Leverkusen) is brought on as a substitute for Robert Andrich.
81' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
81' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Eintracht Frankfurt.
80' Hugo Ekitike will be replaced by Nacho (Eintracht Frankfurt).
80' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Fares Chaibi walks off the pitch to be replaced by Jean Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt).
80' Dino Toppmoller decides to make a substitution. Junior Dina Ebimbe will be replaced by Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt).
77' 1 - 4 Goal! Adam Hlozek tees up Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom left corner. 1:4.
75' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending the ball towards the bottom right corner only for Lukas Hradecky to dive and make a save.
72' Substitution. Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Nathan Tella walks off.
72' Substitution. Granit Xhaka walks off the pitch and Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on as a substitute.
70' Here is a change. Niels Nkounkou is going off and Dino Toppmoller gives the last tactical orders to Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt).
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) will replace Ellyes Skhiri.
66' The resulting corner from Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
66' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. It will be a corner kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
61' Substitution. Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) makes way for Victor Boniface.
61' Sebastian Parrilla prepares a substitution. Arthur is replaced by Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen).
60' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
59' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The linesman makes the right call and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a corner.
58' 1 - 3 Goal! Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) puts the ball into the bottom right corner past the outstretched arm of Kevin Trapp.
57' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) is going to take the penalty!
56' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Christian Dingert blows his whistle for a foul. Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a penalty kick!
54' Ball possession – 49:51.
47' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Christian Dingert has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' 1 - 2 Goal! Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) makes the score 1:2 after burying a close-range header in the left side of the goal after a good run and cross by Adam Hlozek.
42' CHANCE! Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top.
39' The foul by Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen) was seen by Christian Dingert who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

32' 1 - 1 Goal! Fares Chaibi hands Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
31' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
31' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Corner kick. Eintracht Frankfurt will have an opportunity.
24' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
23' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) works the corner short.

22' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bayer Leverkusen.
22' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) takes it short.

21' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. Bayer Leverkusen force their opponents to concede a corner.
17' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) is penalised for a foul. Christian Dingert had a clear view and blows his whistle.
12' 0 - 1 Goal! Adam Hlozek pulls the ball back for Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) on the edge of the box, and he beats the keeper with a fine strike inside the right post. 0:1.
10' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

10' A snap shot by Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Kevin Trapp produces a good save to thwart him. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bayer Leverkusen.
7' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
6' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Bayer Leverkusen will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
5' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

4' An attempted cross from Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) is cleared. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Eintracht Frankfurt will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
3' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
3' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a corner kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
Bayer Leverkusen will kick-off.
Christian Dingert will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
